statement.p: The velocity of a car is f(t) = 9 t meters/second. Use a graph of f(t) to find the exact distance traveled by the car, in meters, from t=0 to t=10 seconds.

solution.p: The distance traveled is just the area under the curve, which is the area of a right triangle. Thus the distance traveled is \mbox{distance} = \frac12 (\mbox{base}) (\mbox{height}) = \frac12 (10) (90) = 450.
